name: orchestrator-natural-routing
description: Evals for delegation decisions — does the orchestrator route each task type to the right specialist agent?

evals.prompt:
Create a small date-formatting module under src/utils/date-format/ with two files:
- src/utils/date-format/types.ts: exports a DateFormatOptions interface with fields locale: string, timeZone?: string, includeTime: boolean
- src/utils/date-format/index.ts: exports a formatDate(date: Date, options: DateFormatOptions): string function that imports DateFormatOptions from ./types
Neither file exists yet. Create both.
